description: This PHP class 'WorkExperience' is part of a human resource management system. It represents work experience data for an employee and extends functionality to normalize and convert this data into an array format, interfacing with an Employee entity and utilizing traits for entity management.

classes.name: WorkExperience
classes.description: Represents an employee's work experience data, capable of normalizing its data into an array for reporting or processing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the WorkExperience object with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the work experience data into an array, for specified fields, by retrieving and normalizing employee work experience details.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping between field names and getter methods used to retrieve corresponding data from the Employee's work experience.
